PRE_DECLARED_headline_and_sensitivity.THE_DECLARATION: The headline DANN x nb3 figure is the 5-fold mean at the declared budget of 4000. The 5-fold mean at step 2000 is reported as a BUDGET-SENSITIVITY CHECK and does not replace it, WHICHEVER IS HIGHER.
PRE_DECLARED_headline_and_sensitivity.correction_to_the_brief: brief v14 2 says '4000 with 32 checkpoints, spacing 125, so step 2000 is checkpoint 16' and prices it at 'five extra checkpoints'. ckpt_every is a fixed 250, so it is 16 checkpoints at spacing 250 and step 2000 is checkpoint 8. The conclusion is STRONGER than the brief's: the readout costs nothing at all.
PRE_DECLARED_headline_and_sensitivity.cost: ZERO. ckpt_every is 250 and the budget is 4000, so a confirmatory fold writes 16 checkpoints at 250-step spacing and STEP 2000 IS CHECKPOINT 8 OF 16 on every fold. Its logits are persisted natively during the run. No extra checkpoints, no extra scoring, no config change.
PRE_DECLARED_headline_and_sensitivity.status: PRE-DECLARED 2026-09-02, BEFORE ANY CONFIRMATORY FOLD EXISTS. This is the whole point of recording it now.
PRE_DECLARED_headline_and_sensitivity.what_it_answers: it converts the cross-budget objection from an argument into a table row: at CORAL's budget DANN scores X, at its own declared budget Y.
PRE_DECLARED_headline_and_sensitivity.why_now: two numbers with the choice of headline made afterwards is selection wearing a disclosure. The ordering fixed in advance is what makes it a sensitivity check instead.

THE_RULE: Budget = 2 x the lambda horizon, so that half of each confirmatory run trains at fixed adversarial strength. Derived from DANN's own configuration; reads no metric.

alternatives_considered_and_declined.1250: the two 1-sd rules, which coincide here (0.5000). DECLINED for the same reason: early regime, local sd 0.164915.
alternatives_considered_and_declined.1750: the argmax (0.5816). DECLINED on 7.11's winner's-curse precedent, and it sits in the early regime where the GLOBAL sd used by such rules describes neither phase (local sd 0.153129).
alternatives_considered_and_declined.2000: CORAL-matched (CORAL x nb3's verified budget; FreeMatch x nb3's is 1500, not 2000). DECLINED: places all folds inside the lambda ramp. CORAL HAS NO RAMP and FreeMatch has none either, so neither budget faced an analogous constraint and neither could carry across. This is NOT a claim that their budgets were wrong.
alternatives_considered_and_declined.3000: a cheaper point still past every fold's transition. DECLINED in favour of a rule statable as a round fraction. RECORDED BECAUSE IT IS THE FALLBACK if the hours become a problem: 7.7 GPU-h against 10.2, and it clears the transition by 750 steps.
alternatives_considered_and_declined.8000: last checkpoint -- R1 applying, with no budget selection to defend. DECLINED ON COST: 20.5 GPU-h against 10.2, to move the fold-0 reading +0.0163 and the local scatter 0.040577 -> 0.035348.

basis_note: NOT a pure cost declaration as CORAL x nb3's was, and NOT derived from the metric. The rule reads DANN's own configuration (the lambda horizon) and no metric; the fold-0 curve is then checked for CONSISTENCY with it. The rule is statable without opening a curve file, which is how a reader can verify it was not chosen to select a value.

confirmatory_design.abort_modes: conditions 1 and 2 ARMED; conditions 3 and 4 ADVISORY on every arm (v10 4).
confirmatory_design.arm1_folds_1_4: CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- see prereg arm1_folds_1_4_declined
confirmatory_design.comparison: fold-mean vs fold-mean (PROJECT.md 2: pooling is invalid for per-fold models)
confirmatory_design.fold0: DEVELOPMENT -- excluded from every headline number
confirmatory_design.note: this file must exist and be hashed BEFORE any confirmatory fold runs
confirmatory_design.timing_of_this_decision: made AFTER fold 0, BY DESIGN. 7.14 specifies a fold-0 development run for exactly this purpose. The rule reads no metric, so the post-fold-0 timing does not make it a selection -- it could have been stated before fold 0 ran and would have given the same number.

corroboration_NOT_derivation.note: the fold-0 curve's settled regime begins around 2250, consistent with the rule; and the reading at 4000 (0.4633) is UNREMARKABLE against the settled mean (0.4787) -- 0.27 settled-sds away. THE RULE WAS NOT CHOSEN TO SELECT A VALUE, and this is the check that it did not accidentally land on a favourable one.

cost_accounting.measured_breakdown: 306.8 min total for arm 2 = ~241 min training + 65.8 min scoring 32 checkpoints
cost_accounting.note: scoring cost is per CHECKPOINT and the checkpoint count scales with the budget, so this is close to linear in steps.

freematch_nb3.CORRECTION: an earlier note said NO COMPARABLE FIGURE EXISTS because 'its fold-0 curve stops at 1500'. That read FreeMatch's CONFIRMATORY fold-0 run, which stops at 1500 because 1500 IS ITS BUDGET. Its fold-0 DEVELOPMENT curve -- runs/freematch_fold0_nb3_unfrozen/curve.csv -- runs 0..8000 at stride 125, and 32 of its points land on the matched 250-stride grid. The figure exists and is given here.

stability_context.note: 32-checkpoint 250-8000 grid, fold 0, TPR@1e-3. Context for the budget's sensitivity, not an argument for any value.
stability_context.ordering: arm 1 (0.276) > arm 2 (0.202) > FreeMatch (0.147) > CORAL (0.118). ARM 1 HAS NO ADVERSARY, so unfreezing WITHOUT a DA term is the least stable of the three -- if anything the adversarial term stabilises relative to plain fine-tuning at nb3. Arms 1 and 2 share an init, fold, seed, GPU and grid and differ in lambda alone, so that contrast is controlled; CORAL shares none of it and is context, not a matched comparison.

why_the_rule.the_transition: lambda = tanh(5*step/2000) pins at ~1.0 near step 2000, so EVERY confirmatory fold has its own transition at the same absolute step, and the budget decides which side of it all four folds report from.
why_the_rule.what_that_rules_out: a budget of 2000 would place all four folds in the EARLY regime, at 2.3x the within-fold scatter, on a round where 7.16 records a realised half-width of ~0.08 at 98 positives. 4000 places every fold well inside the settled regime rather than at its edge.
